# Reviewed SHA-256 allowlist for the Ferrum Edge validator binary.
#
# Format: <64 lowercase hex sha256>  ferrum-edge-linux-x86_64  # <date/note>
#
# Upstream publishes a single rolling `latest` release and deletes plus
# re-uploads its assets on every build, so release ids, asset ids and tags are
# all mutable. Content is the only stable pin. `install-ferrum-edge.sh` resolves
# the asset by name, verifies the publisher's own checksum, and then refuses to
# make the bytes executable unless the digest appears below.
#
# Keep one line per approved build. Retaining the previous line means a refresh
# does not break in-flight pull requests that still run against the older
# binary. Regenerate a line with:
#
#   bash .github/scripts/refresh-ferrum-edge-pin.sh --append
db496ec730d4ec6bf7c03eff21649ba859e236356d843c37da9700c28215dfdb  ferrum-edge-linux-x86_64  # 2026-09-02T03:02:29Z release latest
